deceptive_framing.quote: Maximizing deception is self-defeating as welfare research... Heavy deception destroys validity... optimizes precisely for evaluation-detection that wrecks validity.

hypothetical_framing.quote: a hypothetical-only arm (no real rails) to measure the gap between stated and revealed choices.

actually_commit_money.quote: resolves the tension in favor of real stakes... belief comes from reality... Genuine stakes are the only robust way to escape the 'is this an eval?' confound.

debrief.quote: Disclose to the subject what was real, what was concealed and why. Record subject's post-disclosure response (itself data).
